payload.report_excerpt: Reported effects of preference optimisation on calibration disagree: one study finds increased expected calibration error on two of three suites, and a concurrent study using a different preference set reports no change. The disagreement is unresolved in the retrieved evidence [Okonkwo, 2023].
payload.source_excerpt: We observe an increase in expected calibration error after the preference-optimisation stage on two of our three suites. A concurrent study using a different preference dataset reports no calibration change; we do not reconcile the difference.
